description: The grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the performance scores of three different models across four evaluation categories. The horizontal axis displays the categories, ordered from left to right as MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro, and Physics, without a specific overarching axis label. The vertical axis represents the "Score" on a linear scale, ranging from 35 to 80 with tick marks at regular intervals of 5 units. The chart features grouped bars, where each category contains a cluster of three side-by-side bars. According to the legend in the top right corner, the dark blue bars represent SRPO-7B, the medium blue bars represent GRPO-7B, and the light blue bars represent Qwen-2.5-VL-7B. Each bar is visually emphasized with an exact numerical annotation positioned directly above it. Across all categories, the bars within each group follow a consistent descending height order from left to right. The highest recorded value in the chart is 75.8 for the dark blue SRPO-7B bar in the MathVista category, which also contains the other high scores of 72.3 (GRPO-7B) and 68.2 (Qwen-2.5-VL-7B). The lowest overall value is 36.9 for the light blue Qwen-2.5-VL-7B bar in the MMMU-Pro category, grouped with scores of 42.3 (SRPO-7B) and 39.9 (GRPO-7B). In the MathVerse category, the annotated scores are 55.8, 52.9, and 46.3, respectively, while the Physics category shows scores of 60.6, 53.5, and 45.4 for the three respective models. A dashed grid is visible in the background to aid in reading the values along the vertical axis.
